Jillean Williams, a poised and delightful Englishwoman, is the wife of Joe Williams. She met Joe in 1957, at the height of his tenure with the Count Basie Band. Jillean and Joe were married in 1959. They currently reside in Las Vegas, Nevada.
Jillean was interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe at Hamilton College on

This is part of the preparation for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, which will deal primarily with the days of the Basie band and the life of Joe Williams. We are pleased to have with us today Jillean Williams, who is the wife of Joe, and who has been part of the scene with the Basie band and with Joe for many years. I’d like to ask you if you would tell us how you first met Joe and how the romance developed into a marriage.
